value.text: useMemoQueries.ts looks like a good candidate for the CRUD queries and mutations, so I'll check it along with any store folder for a Zustand-style store.

Confirmed: this file defines `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo` (mutations) plus `useMemos`, `useMemo`, `useMemoComments`, etc. (queries), all built on `memoServiceClient` imported from `@/connect`. Let's check that client definition.

`memoServiceClient` is a Connect-RPC client created from the generated `MemoService` (defined in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`, generated from `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`).

q17. `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient` (a `@connectrpc/connect` client built from the generated `MemoService` in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`, instantiated in `web/src/connect.ts`)

This file (`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`) defines all the memo CRUD hooks — `useMemos`/`useInfiniteMemos`/`useMemo` (read), `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo` (mutations), plus comment/link-metadata queries. Every one of these calls into `memoServiceClient` (imported from `web/src/connect.ts`), which is a Connect-RPC client created via `createClient(MemoService, transport)`, where `MemoService` is the generated service descriptor from `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts` (generated from the `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` definition).
